question: What went wrong with Cells 7 and 8 at their first FAT, and what was the root cause?
source: Factory Acceptance Test Report - Cells 1 to 8 (QRL-VAR-FAT-001 rev C)
evidence: Cells 7 and 8 failed their first FAT on positional accuracy only (0.21 mm and 0.19 mm respectively, against the requirement of ≤ 0.15 mm) and passed on re-test. | Root cause: the thermal compensation parameters of the robot controller had not been re-set for the 14 m track, and the joint between the second and third new-generation track sections was out of alignment by 0.08 mm.
note: Both failed only on B1 positional accuracy (Cell 7 0.21 mm on 1 July 2024, Cell 8 0.19 mm on 8 July 2024, against ≤ 0.15 mm), in the last 4 m of track. Root cause (NCR-031/NCR-033): the robot controller's thermal compensation was not re-set for the 14 m track, and the joint between the second and third track sections was 0.08 mm out of line. Both passed re-test on 22 and 29 July 2024.
